title: Cooldown-Gated Special Attacks
description: Attack selection with a priority selector: a dramatic rocket attack gated by a cooldown decorator, falling back to shooting while ammo lasts, then melee. Note the cooldown wraps the whole rocket sequence, not just the range check.

custom_nodes.name: Cooldown
custom_nodes.title: Cooldown <milliseconds>ms
custom_nodes.description: Fails without running its child until the cooldown has elapsed since the last completed run.

custom_nodes.name: IsPlayerInRange
custom_nodes.title: Is Player In Range?
custom_nodes.description: Succeeds if the player is within the given range.

custom_nodes.name: FireRocket
custom_nodes.title: Fire Rocket
custom_nodes.description: Fires the rocket launcher at the player.

custom_nodes.name: HasAmmo
custom_nodes.title: Has Ammo?
custom_nodes.description: Succeeds if the primary weapon has ammunition left.

custom_nodes.name: ShootPlayer
custom_nodes.title: Shoot Player
custom_nodes.description: Fires the primary weapon at the player.

custom_nodes.name: MeleeAttack
custom_nodes.title: Melee Attack
custom_nodes.description: Unconditional fallback: swings at the player up close.

n1.name: Priority
n1.title: Choose Attack
n1.description: Prefers the special whenever it is legal, degrading gracefully to basic attacks.
